artboards.title: Jump to a comment's original diff

annotations.text:
Open questions:
· commit panel: show parent links as navigation?

Diff scope model:
· All changes: main → branch tip, with a '+ working tree' toggle to fold uncommitted changes in (off = committed only).
· By commit: each commit vs its parent; working tree is the last step. Comments carry the pair they were made on.

Threads model (settled):
· inline threads in the diff are primary
· Conversation tab aggregates every thread chronologically — review-level, file-anchored (with quoted lines + jump link), resolved (collapsed), outdated (jump opens the original diff).
· Browse comments anchor to a file@ref, no diff pair.
· Browse's 'viewing' picker offers any ref — branch, tag, commit, worktree (the daemon's tree snapshots already take an arbitrary RefSpec).

Keyboard (settled):
· canonical bindings are TERMINAL-SAFE (the same core keymap will drive the TUI): single keys + ctrl only — ctrl+k palette, ctrl+p files, / find-in-file; ⌘K/⌘P/⌘⇧F are GUI-only aliases shown in mac tooltips
· minimal modality: no vim modes; only text inputs capture keys (Esc leaves); everything else is focus-context single keys — j/k rows (arrows too, unadvertised) · n/p hunks · ]f [f files · c comment · r reply · v viewed · s split · w whitespace · x expand · 1/2/3 tabs · Esc back
· user-configurable: ~/.config/moor/keys.toml overrides per-context bindings; commands are an enum so bad entries fail loudly at load; hints, ? help and button tooltips all re-derive from the loaded keymap (one source of truth)
· every control is a mouse alias for a chord; hover shows the shortcut; pane focus tab/shift-tab; resizing (if built) ⌥←/→, ⌥0 reset
